# Taxi provider artwork status

Reviewed 28 October 2026.

- **13cabs:** bundled genuine vector artwork in `13cabs.svg`; see `13cabs-source.md` for the exact source and revision.
- **Suburban Taxis, Adelaide Independent Taxis and Access Taxis:** no brand artwork is bundled. The prototype should use a neutral taxi symbol for these entries rather than invented provider logos.

The remaining gap is asset retrieval, not a missing graphics package or browser runtime. Direct shell asset requests failed with DNS resolution errors in this session. The connected web reader can inspect provider pages but does not expose downloadable raw image/SVG bytes. Searches of the available connected GitHub source reader did not find usable logo assets for these three providers. No network restrictions were bypassed.

Official provider reference pages:

- Suburban Taxis: https://www.suburbantaxis.com.au/
- Adelaide Independent Taxis: https://www.aitaxis.com.au/contact.html
- Access Taxis contact reference: https://www.suburbantaxis.com.au/adelaide/book (Access Taxi Booking section)

These links identify the providers; they are not represented as licenses for redistributing their artwork. Replace the neutral symbols only after genuine assets have been obtained from an appropriate source.
